chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from some of his companions, from al-ʿAlāʾ ibn Razīn, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام about a boy who steals, so he said: “If he is nine years old, his hand is cut off, and no hadd from the hudud of Allah is neglected.”

key_terms.حُدُودِ اللَّهِ: the legal limits and prescribed punishments set by Allah
key_terms.قُطِعَتْ يَدُهُ: his hand is cut off as the legal penalty

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling in Tahdhib al-Ahkam on a nine-year-old child who commits theft?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning theft committed by a minor and specifies a threshold of nine years in relation to the implementation of the hadd. It emphasizes that the hudud of Allah are not to be neglected when their conditions are met.
